RowLevelPolicies.PolicyDescription: A signed-in customer may read their own commerce profile.
Placeholder: scope to Order manager / Customer-support roles once those exist (Phase 0 role model). Currently admin-only.
A signed-in customer may edit their own commerce profile.
Only administrators may permanently delete records.

Fields.Name: ItemId
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the record. System-generated and immutable once created.

Fields.Name: CreatedDate
Fields.Description: UTC timestamp when the record was first created. Automatically set on insert.

Fields.Name: LastUpdatedDate
Fields.Description: UTC timestamp of the most recent update. Automatically refreshed on write.

Fields.Name: CreatedBy
Fields.Description: User ID that created the record. Derived from the authentication context.

Fields.Name: Language
Fields.Description: ISO language code for localized content, when applicable.

Fields.Name: LastUpdatedBy
Fields.Description: User ID that last modified the record.

Fields.Name: OrganizationId
Fields.Description: Tenant or organization identifier used for data isolation.

Fields.Name: Tags
Fields.Description: Searchable tags associated with the record.

Fields.Name: UserId
Fields.Description: IAM user id this commerce profile belongs to. One profile per authenticated user.

Fields.Name: Email
Fields.Description: Contact email for order confirmations and receipts.

Fields.Name: FirstName
Fields.Description: Given name.

Fields.Name: LastName
Fields.Description: Family name.

Fields.Name: Phone
Fields.Description: Contact phone number.

Fields.Name: Addresses
Fields.Description: Saved shipping/billing addresses for this customer.

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Lifecycle status: active, inactive, or archived.

Fields.Name: ProductId
Fields.Description: Product this line refers to.

Fields.Name: VariantId
Fields.Description: Sellable variant this line refers to.

Fields.Name: Sku
Fields.Description: SKU snapshot at the time the line was added.

Fields.Name: NameSnapshot
Fields.Description: Product/variant display name snapshot, so the cart still reads correctly if the catalog changes later.

Fields.Name: Slug
Fields.Description: Product slug snapshot, so a cart line synced from another device can still link to the product page.

Fields.Name: ImageUrl
Fields.Description: Thumbnail image URL snapshot, so a cart line synced from another device can still render an image.

Fields.Name: UnitPrice
Fields.Description: Snapshot of the variant's unit price when this line was added or last revalidated.

Fields.Name: Quantity
Fields.Description: Quantity of this variant in the cart.

Fields.Name: Currency
Fields.Description: ISO currency code for UnitPrice.

RowLevelPolicies.PolicyDescription: A signed-in customer may read only their own cart.
A signed-in customer may edit only their own cart.
A signed-in customer may delete only their own cart.
Only administrators may permanently delete records.

Fields.Name: ItemId
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the record. System-generated and immutable once created.

Fields.Name: CreatedDate
Fields.Description: UTC timestamp when the record was first created. Automatically set on insert.

Fields.Name: LastUpdatedDate
Fields.Description: UTC timestamp of the most recent update. Automatically refreshed on write.

Fields.Name: CreatedBy
Fields.Description: User ID that created the record. Derived from the authentication context.

Fields.Name: Language
Fields.Description: ISO language code for localized content, when applicable.

Fields.Name: LastUpdatedBy
Fields.Description: User ID that last modified the record.

Fields.Name: OrganizationId
Fields.Description: Tenant or organization identifier used for data isolation.

Fields.Name: Tags
Fields.Description: Searchable tags associated with the record.

Fields.Name: CustomerId
Fields.Description: IAM UserId of the cart's owner. Set from the authenticated caller on create, never from client input.

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: active, abandoned, or converted (once checked out into an Order).

Fields.Name: Currency
Fields.Description: ISO currency code for all monetary fields on this cart.

Fields.Name: Items
Fields.Description: Line items currently in the cart.

Fields.Name: CouponCode
Fields.Description: Applied coupon code, if any. Revalidate against Coupon rules at checkout, not trusted as-is.

Fields.Name: SubTotal
Fields.Description: Sum of line totals before discount.

Fields.Name: DiscountTotal
Fields.Description: Total discount applied by CouponCode/promotions.

Fields.Name: Total
Fields.Description: SubTotal minus DiscountTotal. Revalidate server-side at checkout — never trust a client-computed Total for payment.

Fields.Name: SalesChannelType
Fields.Description: Ecommerce, POS, MobileApp, Marketplace, or Wholesale — which channel this cart belongs to.

Fields.Name: ProductId
Fields.Description: Product this line refers to.

Fields.Name: VariantId
Fields.Description: Sellable variant this line refers to.

Fields.Name: Sku
Fields.Description: SKU snapshot at order placement time.

Fields.Name: NameSnapshot
Fields.Description: Product/variant display name snapshot at order placement time.

Fields.Name: UnitPrice
Fields.Description: Price snapshot at order placement time. Never recompute from the live catalog after the fact.

Fields.Name: Quantity
Fields.Description: Quantity ordered.

Fields.Name: TaxAmount
Fields.Description: Tax amount snapshot for this line.

Fields.Name: DiscountAmount
Fields.Description: Discount amount snapshot for this line.

Fields.Name: LineTotal
Fields.Description: UnitPrice * Quantity, plus TaxAmount, minus DiscountAmount — the actual charged amount for this line.

RowLevelPolicies.PolicyDescription: A signed-in customer may read only their own orders.
Placeholder: scope to Order manager / Customer-support / Finance roles once those exist (Phase 0 role model). Currently admin-only.

Order status/payment/fulfillment transitions are staff-driven for now. A narrower customer-initiated cancel policy (status in Draft/PendingPayment AND CustomerId == self) is a follow-up, not yet implemented.

Fields.Name: ItemId
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the record. System-generated and immutable once created.

Fields.Name: CreatedDate
Fields.Description: UTC timestamp when the record was first created. Automatically set on insert.

Fields.Name: LastUpdatedDate
Fields.Description: UTC timestamp of the most recent update. Automatically refreshed on write.

Fields.Name: CreatedBy
Fields.Description: User ID that created the record. Derived from the authentication context.

Fields.Name: Language
Fields.Description: ISO language code for localized content, when applicable.

Fields.Name: LastUpdatedBy
Fields.Description: User ID that last modified the record.

Fields.Name: OrganizationId
Fields.Description: Tenant or organization identifier used for data isolation.

Fields.Name: Tags
Fields.Description: Searchable tags associated with the record.

Fields.Name: OrderNumber
Fields.Description: Human-facing order number, generated at placement.

Fields.Name: CustomerId
Fields.Description: IAM UserId of the ordering customer. Set from the authenticated caller on create, never from client input.

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Draft, PendingPayment, Confirmed, Cancelled, or Completed.

Fields.Name: PaymentStatus
Fields.Description: Pending, Authorized, Paid, PartiallyRefunded, Refunded, or Failed.

Fields.Name: FulfillmentStatus
Fields.Description: Unallocated, Allocated, Picking, Packed, PartiallyShipped, Shipped, or Delivered.

Fields.Name: Items
Fields.Description: Line items at the time of placement, with price/tax/discount snapshots — never re-derive these from the live catalog.

Fields.Name: ShippingAddress
Fields.Description: Snapshot of the shipping address at order placement time.

Fields.Name: BillingAddress
Fields.Description: Snapshot of the billing address at order placement time.

Fields.Name: Currency
Fields.Description: ISO currency code for all monetary fields on this order.

Fields.Name: SubTotal
Fields.Description: Sum of line totals before tax/shipping/discount.

Fields.Name: TaxTotal
Fields.Description: Total tax across all lines.

Fields.Name: DiscountTotal
Fields.Description: Total discount across all lines and order-level promotions.

Fields.Name: ShippingTotal
Fields.Description: Shipping charge for this order.

Fields.Name: GrandTotal
Fields.Description: The actual amount charged: SubTotal + TaxTotal + ShippingTotal - DiscountTotal.

Fields.Name: CouponCode
Fields.Description: Coupon code applied at checkout, if any.

Fields.Name: IdempotencyKey
Fields.Description: Client-generated key reused on every retry of the same checkout attempt. IsUniqueData alone is a check-then-act query, not a real constraint — a genuine MongoDB unique index must also be created on this field before this is trustworthy for production checkout (see DATA_GATEWAY_STORAGE_FEATURES_AND_SECURITY.md item B2).

Fields.Name: SalesChannelType
Fields.Description: Ecommerce, POS, MobileApp, Marketplace, or Wholesale.

Fields.Name: PlacedDate
Fields.Description: When the order was placed.

Fields.Name: ConfirmedDate
Fields.Description: When payment/confirmation completed.

Fields.Name: CancelledDate
Fields.Description: When the order was cancelled, if applicable.
